name: source_ref
description: Where this record's wording or evidence comes from.

aiGuidance.purpose: Points an objective or stakeholder back to the plan, file or issue that states it, so the record is a reader's index and not a second copy.
aiGuidance.extraction: One entry per source: a repo-relative path with its repo (muDemocracy.org/plans/roadmap-2026Q4-2027Q3.md) or an issue in repo#number form.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not paste the source's text here; summary and body carry prose.
